summary: Always-visible list of violet-option children for choosing one value, or several with multiple; not a form field.

usage.text: It is not form-associated and has no name attribute. Read the value property, or selectedValues in multiple mode, and submit it yourself.
With multiple, the selection is the selectedValues array property (no attribute) and value mirrors its first entry. Options marked selected seed it.
User selection fires input and change with detail.value, plus detail.selectedValues in multiple mode. selectValue(v) and toggleValue(v) fire them too unless their second argument is false.

One tab stop. Arrows, Home, End and type-ahead move the highlight; Enter or Space selects, or toggles in multiple mode, where Ctrl or Cmd+A toggles all. selection-follows-focus selects while moving, single mode only.

a11y.text: The label attribute is not rendered: it becomes the list's aria-label, falling back to an aria-label on the host and then to "Options". Provide one of them.
